_comment: The dashboard under /app/ is a Next static export built with
basePath '/madeea-os/app', because GitHub Pages serves this repo from
https://thelbertd.github.io/madeea-os/. Every asset URL in the HTML is
Vercel serves the repo at the domain root, so those URLs 404 and the page
renders as unstyled HTML. Rewriting /madeea-os/* to /* makes the existing
build work here untouched — no second build, and GitHub Pages is unaffected
